about: The API around General fitting its column (ADR-0047, SH-20). What Excel shows at each width is in ExcelCases' general-width; these pin what is the engine's own. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' GeneralWidthTests.

cases.name: ADR-0047: the width changes only the text; the Value, and the unfitted display, stay whole
ADR-0016/0047: what General cannot fit is ####, reported as a number that cannot show
ADR-0047: a column holds its whole characters; a round trip through pixels may land a hair below a whole number (width 8.43)
ADR-0047: a column holds its whole characters; a round trip through pixels may land a hair below a whole number (width 8.99)
ADR-0047: a column holds its whole characters; a round trip through pixels may land a hair below a whole number (width 8.9999999999)
ADR-0047: a column holds its whole characters; a round trip through pixels may land a hair below a whole number (width 9)
ADR-0047: a width is a finite number of characters (-1)
ADR-0047: a width is a finite number of characters (NaN)
ADR-0047: a width is a finite number of characters (Infinity)
ADR-0047: text, booleans and Error Values are never fitted
ADR-0047: a blank cell needs no width and shows nothing at any width
